title: Wendell and the Drop
author: Sable Thornbury
blurb: Silas Galloway, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trade the one secret worth killing for before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
